core_mechanic: Procedural runs with permadeath and meta-progression carry-over.
player_motivation: Translate accumulated knowledge into longer runs.

essential_feel.run_length: 20–40 min ideal; punchy enough to retry willingly
essential_feel.death: Educational; reveals systems rather than punishing

pacing_profile.early: Onboarding run with guaranteed wins to teach systems.
pacing_profile.late: Heat / ascension layers extend skill ceiling indefinitely.

progression_model.completion_definition: Infinite replay; soft-credits on first clear, true ending after N successful runs, ascension/heat layers carry indefinitely.
progression_model.content_cadence: Every run; new biome/build/perk unlocks gated by meta-currency tiers.

canonical_examples.title: Dead Cells
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Tight 2D combat with deep weapon-perk synergies.

anti_patterns: Power gap that makes early runs feel unwinnable
Reward unlocks gated behind RNG with no pity timer
